name: awhittlewandering
description: 48 Continental US Tesla Road Trip Tracker

scripts.build:all: bun run build:shared && bun run build:backend && bun run build:frontend
scripts.deploy: npm run predeploy && bun run build && ./scripts/deploy.sh && npm run postdeploy
scripts.deploy:major: npm run qa:major-deployment && npm run deploy
scripts.deploy:frontend: cd frontend && bun run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=awhittlewandering-frontend
scripts.deploy:frontend:quick: cd frontend && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=awhittlewandering-frontend
scripts.postdeploy: cd qa && node -e "import('./qa-data-manager.js').then(m => new m.QADataManager().logComponentActivity('deployment', 'deployment-complete', 'info', 'Deployment completed successfully', { timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }))"
scripts.qa:dashboard: cd qa && node -e "import('./cloud-qa-runner.js').then(m => m.CloudQARunner).then(C => new C().getQADashboard()).then(console.log)"
scripts.cloud:setup: cd qa && npx wrangler d1 create qa-pipeline-db && npx wrangler d1 execute qa-pipeline-db --file=cloudflare-d1-setup.sql --remote
scripts.cloud:status: cd qa && npx wrangler d1 info qa-pipeline-db
scripts.cloud:update-schema: cd qa && npx wrangler d1 execute qa-pipeline-db --file=cloudflare-d1-updates.sql --remote
